Do you have plantar fasciitis or that foot pain that simply never goes away?  If you’re wearing narrow shoes like this, that might be the reason. Your toes are meant to spread like a human.  Let me show you how to relieve the pain!  In order to have normal human function, you need to have 15 to 20° of ankle dorsiflexion.  If you don’t have that range of motion, put your foot up on a stable surface.  Put your forearm on your leg and bring your leg forward, grab onto the surface and track your knee over your pinky toe, then over your big toe.  Wherever you’re tightest, hold it for five seconds, back it off, and do that 12 times.  After you’ve normalized that ankle range of motion, you need to get your toes spread again.  Take your index finger and put it in between your first two toes, starting at the big toe. The rest of your fingers can follow!  Grab onto your foot or ankle, pull your foot apart, and ring it out like a towel. This will mobilize the joints so your foot can function better. Do this 15 to 20 times in each spot. Perform these moves anytime you have pain to get rid of it, and to get better not older! 🔥🦶 #GetBetterNotOlder #GBNO #HeyDrRob #ChiropractorApproved #PlantarFasciitis
